verdict.rationale: Jira ships Rovo AI features for automations and an official MCP server (atlassian-mcp-server) that lets AI agents interact with Jira, implying natural-language operation is possible via connected assistants, but there is no first-party documentation of an in-product natural-language command interface or hands-on evidence of it working reliably. Missing for 10: direct documentation/demo of natural-language command execution within Jira itself, independent user validation of AI-assist command accuracy.
